Factory Town shares Factory Basel 2026 lineup

Featuring Carlita, Chris Lake, PAWSA, Solomun, The Martinez Brothers, and more.

Photo credit: Alive Coverage

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:32
Instaread

Factory Town has unveiled the first lineup wave for Factory Basel 2026, bringing five nights of music, art, and late-night programming from December 2 through December 6. The program will unfold across all five stages with artist-led concepts, label showcases, and party-brand takeovers.

The lineup features Carlita, Chloé Caillet, Chris Lake, Dixon, GORDO, HoneyLuv, Luciano, Palms Trax, PAWSA, Prospa, Rampa, salute, Seth Troxler, Solomun, The Martinez Brothers, and more.

Stage presenters include Carlita Presents Senza Fine, Chloé Caillet Presents SMIILE, Franky Rizardo Presents FLOW, GORDO Presents TARAKA, Luciano Presents Vagabundos, Malóne Morez Presents WHYNOTUS, Omar+ Presents Omar Plus Friends, OMRI. Presents Collecting Dots, Rafael Presents Cheetah Print, salute Presents Infinite Passion, and Solomun Presents Diynamic. Circoloco, Deep House Bible, elrow, Factory 93, and Revival are also part of the program, alongside additional programming from GENNARO, NAIMA, and Zack Fox.

The week will also feature collaborative sets including Carlita b2b Ben Sterling, Dennis Ferrer b2b Rafael, DJ Minx b2b DJ Holographic, Franky Rizardo b2b The Martinez Brothers, HAAi b2b Coffintexts, Make A Dance b2b Paula Tape, salute b2b TEED, Solomun b2b Chris Lake, and Zack Fox b2b Jyoty.

Visual art will once again form part of Factory Basel 2026, curated by Known Gallery’s Casey Zoltan. This year’s program will introduce new murals, art installations, a group exhibition, a cloBBer pop-up activation, and a special surprise event alongside Factory Town’s permanent collection.

More information and tickets are available here.
